tasks.outcome: Clarify worker completion versus runner check execution, checkpoint and review dispatch (A1).
tasks.description: Read docs/plans/workflow-completion-recovery-tasks.md#shared-worker-and-reviewer-context and the linked TinySpec acceptance for this outcome. Carry those binding constraints and this task's REQUIRED observables, paths and dependencies into worker/reviewer briefs. Source A1. Update _COMPLETION_REPORTING and only causal task/fixer prompt text in engine.py plus the report_task_outcome tool description in host.mjs. Worker finishes assigned implementation and worker-owned semantic/manual evidence, reports actual blockers and returns. Runner executes/reruns configured checks, creates the focused checkpoint and dispatches fresh independent review; it does not own all semantic/manual judgment or the reviewer verdict. Pending runner stages alone do not require unsuccessful status. A reasoned correction awaiting a promised runner rerun does not waive that rerun. Keep explicit unsuccessful handling unchanged: no prose inference, forced success, extra judge/model call or worker commit. Extend the existing stage/authority/repair fixtures named below with captured ownership instructions and positive/unsuccessful controls; update current operating/schema wording. Exclude diagnostics transport, attribution and new settled-fixer handling.

required.description: REQUIRED: Actual Engine/disposable Git: completed worker return reaches real configured command, focused checkpoint and fresh read-only review in order. Keep genuinely completed no-command/no-change (no empty commit), corrected ordinary-error and successful runner-rerun controls. Failed or genuinely unrun worker-owned semantic/manual acceptance remains unsuccessful even with green baseline commands. Explicit incomplete saying only runner review remains still stops; blocked/failed/incomplete with no edits or partial edits do not release dependent B, success checkpoint, session settlement or success-path review/fixer. Extend existing fixtures rather than add a new platform.

REQUIRED: Inspect registered tool description and captured initial/corrective/already-supported resumed task and fixer prompts: precise ownership, unchanged ADR-0003 current-launch authority and shared ADR-0004 _ROUTINE_AUTHORITY/exclusions. New settled-fixer handling is T004, not a prerequisite here. Preserve worker semantic/manual evidence, actual owner/manual/paid/security/data/external gates and unknown-byte protection; no historical rewrite, routine consent or acknowledgment wake. Evidence is prompt/tool capture plus actual exits, Git/history and dispatch order, not live obedience.
REQUIRED: Extend these existing actual stage and unsuccessful controls; positive no-change/corrected-error assertions belong with them.
REQUIRED: Extend focused existing authority/correction/resume captures and fixer correction context for the changed shared prompt.
REQUIRED: Inspect completion description in the existing SDK registration fixture without provider calls. Missing SDK is unavailable, not permission to install or a passing result.

tasks.description: Read docs/plans/workflow-completion-recovery-tasks.md#shared-worker-and-reviewer-context and the linked TinySpec acceptance for this outcome. At the failed-fixer boundary inspect actual cause/call and source/check/Git effects; choose the smallest supported targeted correction using existing resume, coordinator diagnosis, session/scoped-repair and history interfaces. A missing runtime branch is a technical gap to correct autonomously, not an authority limitation or reason to hand routine debugging to the owner. Continue where supported; only an evidenced actual binding authority limit may instead yield a precise supported next action. Do not preselect same-assignment mechanics or require saved-session reopening universally. Reuse existing records/session/effect facts; add only a missing fact actually consumed by the selected path, with diagnosis and consumer in this outcome. No inventory/ledger/schema, speculative capture or separate persistence task. Keep failed/rejection truth, partial work and exact grants/assigned identities/scope/range/settings/historical policy. No new round or replacement pair disguised as continuation, uncertain replay, completed-task replay, path adoption, hook/signing bypass or automatic retry service. Preserve worker semantic/manual acceptance and actual configured check execution, owned-effect reconciliation/checkpoint and fresh independent full-original-range verdict before completion. Extend the existing adapter/resume/chain seam and current coordinator/operating/schema contracts only as needed by this supported path. Exclude attribution redesign and generalized recovery.

required.description: REQUIRED: Small actual Engine/adapter/Git fixture reproduces rejection → settled unsuccessful fixer → inspected diagnosis/targeted correction → supported handling. Extend the existing adapter/resume fixture seam below; exercise process restart for the retained-resume case where the chosen path depends on it, without turning persisted session inventories into acceptance. Where continuation is supported, observe real checks, focused owned checkpoint (or genuine no-change), fresh original-range review, retained rejection/failed-call history and no completed-task replay; fresh verdict alone accepts delivery. If a real authority limit prevents continuation, demonstrate its binding rule, affected operation and actionable supported next step, not a generic dead end. Missing branch, ordinary technical error or agent uncertainty is not such a rule; no unchanged retry or routine owner-debugging handoff.

REQUIRED: Include one uncertain-call no-replay control at the changed continuation boundary. Reuse applicable existing grant/ownership/effect-reconciliation evidence; rerun or extend only checks invalidated by the selected correction or required for an exposed safety boundary. Preserve actual grants/assigned identities and failed-stage replacement guards, scope/range/settings and historical policy; no new mandatory first/additional-pair variants or exhaustive recovery matrix. Required/manual acceptance failures cannot be waived, unknown bytes cannot be adopted, and unsuccessful work cannot checkpoint/review as accepted.

Apply memory routine technical autonomy/no acknowledgment wakes and correction-only affected behavior without removing full-original-range independent review. Compare current docs with actual supported handling; report any specific missing consumed fact with operation/corrective action, not a general new admission rule. Stubs prove mechanical flow, not autonomous judgment.
